en: In that case, ya better keep on drinkin' there!
I intend to. Maybe even order some champagne...
Hahaha! Oh, you're such a cool guy, Akiyama-san!
I intend to. Well, I would, except I'm short on cash today.
What!? This is worse than bein' stingy. It's super uncool to talk game like that when you're broke.
Maybe next time.
That's the exact opposite of whatcha just said, Akiyama-san! You're supposed to go big right now, not go home...
I'm real good at tongue-twisters. I don't mess up or nothin'.
I'm real good at tongue-twisters!
I heard you the first time. What's wrong with you? Are you drunk or something?
No, I'm not drunk! Geez! That was me danglin' the setup for ya, and you're supposed to pick up on it.
Oh. Okay. Sorry about that.
Let's try that again, yeah?
Say, I'm real good at tongue-twisters!
Oh wow! Let me hear one!
Okay, but just a quickie!
Really? I'm not sure I believe you.
Believe it! I'm super good!
If you say so. Let me hear one.
Let me hear one.
Hehehe! Okay, but just a quickie!
If one froggy hoppity hops twice, then three froggies hoppity hop six times.
How's that?
Impressive! You really do want to be a newscaster, don't you?
Sure do! I'm workin' real hard for it.
Keep it up. Someday all that hard work is bound to pay off.
Hehe! Keep the praise comin'! That sorta feedback helps me improve!
In that case, the next time you think you've improved, be sure to show me. And if you have, I'll be sure to throw more praise your way.
Okay! Next time I'll be able to rattle off that sorta thing even more smoothly!
I look forward to it!
Try harder. It's not an easy feat to become a reporter. Being able to say tongue-twisters isn't the be-all and end-all.
I know all that. All I was sayin' was that I'm good at tongue-twisters and wanted to give ya a demonstration.
I'm tryin' hard at lotsa different things, so try not to be so discouragin'.
That was okay. I bet I could do that.
Ya really think so, huh? Okay then, Akiyama-san. Give it a shot!
Time's up!
What!? Hey, come on. You can't put me on the spot like that.
The ability to ad lib is one a' the things they look for in a reporter. Ya gotta be prepared!
The sixth sleep's sick sheik's...
Ahahaha! Trippin' over yer own tongue there, Akiyama-san! Too bad!
Damn, this is actually really hard.
The sixth sick sheik's sixth sheep's sick.
Whoooa! That's amazin'! You're really good at that, Akiyama-san!
The sixth sock sheik's sick sheesh sheek...
Ahaha! That's not how it goes, silly! Close but no cigar, Akiyama-san!
Oh hey, there's somethin' I wanted to ask ya.
Do ya know what a half-day is?
I do. You mean like at school, when classes end in the morning. Like most Saturdays, I hear.
That's right. I shoulda figured you'd know.
What's that? I've never heard of it.
It's like on Saturdays, when classes only run in the mornin'.
Oh, is that what they call those? I'd never heard that term before.
What about it, anyway?
I was talkin' to another customer and he mentioned half-days, but at the school I went to we always had Saturdays off.
Yeah, recently schools have been getting two days a week off. Back in my day we went to school every Saturday.
My college has classes on Saturdays, and I even went to cram schools before college.
But when I said I'd never heard of a half-day, this guy made fun of me for bein' a slacker at school.
Is that true?
Maybe my generation's got more relaxed education standards, but that ain't the issue. It's not my fault they don't do school on Saturdays.
Yeah, it's not fair to lump you in with that.
What a jerk. Mocking the education system itself is one thing, but what kind of education did this guy get that made him mock you?
Exactly! I'm glad you're not prejudiced against us younger folks, Akiyama-san.
Maybe he wasn't mockin' me just because of my generation's education, but also 'cause I'm a '90s kid. Maybe he wanted a more mature woman?
You were born in the '90s? A lot of the girls I interview for my club were born around then as well. Guess times are changing.
Do you got problems with girls born in the '90s?
It depends.
For real? Why?
When I'm with younger girls, especially cute ones, I try too hard to be cool so she'll like me. As a result, I can't really be myself.
Conversely, I can talk to older women with less reservation, tell dirty jokes, and have fun with silly talk. Sometimes that's more fun for me.
Wow, I figured you were bein' yerself, so I'm surprised, Akiyama-san. So are ya tryin' hard to be cool right now?
Quite the contrary. I get a thrill from the younger generation.
Eww, yer a creepy old man, Akiyama-san! You're not doin' yourself any favors.
No, I meant that as a compliment.
So, when I'm an old lady in my forties or fifties, will ya still think I'm cute because I was born in the '90s?
Hmm. I wonder. By that point we might be extolling the virtues of girls born in the 21st century.
See, I hate people who slap labels on people like that. I'd rather be seen as an individual.
Age doesn't matter to me. It's about the person.
Right!? I don't wanna be told I look stupid just 'cause of my age or looks. I attend a prestigious college, after all.
Customers who pick a girl based on age only look at the numbers, not the girl. They really don't care who they get.
Yeah, I wanna be seen for who I am inside.
Still, a cabaret club needs to meet a client's needs. If a guy simply doesn't like you, that's too bad. You should cut your losses.
Yeah! I'm only gonna make a point to make nice with customers who treat me right!
I'm a huge fan of amusement parks. There's one I hit up about once a week if I don't watch out!
That's amazing. I guess you must've dropped a lot of money on an annual pass.
Yep! I go all the time to make sure I'm gettin' my money's worth!
Really? I didn't know there were people who liked them enough to go that often.
And you don't get bored?
Some things are fun to see over and over! Also, they change the attractions seasonally, so there's stuff to keep me interested.
Do you go on dates? Who do you go with?
Nah, I go by myself, of course.
By yourself? To an amusement park?
Yep. It makes it easier for me to hit up whatever attractions I feel like checkin' out.
I'd never considered going to an amusement park alone before. You must really enjoy it.
I do, but I still ain't seen this year's Christmas show. At this rate, it'll be over before I get a chance to see it.
That's a shame. You should go soon. I take it you're busy lately?
Yeah, I got slammed by exams at school, and since I'm workin' every day now I can't find the time to go.
Why not go before work? Even if you don't have the whole day off, surely you can find two or three hours of free time.
That's no good. There's a limited-edition phone strap ya get if you come with a guest, but I don't have anyone to invite.
They give those away?
They put out a different one every year. I collect 'em.
Wow, I didn't know. I guess you can't afford to miss out on this year's version.
Which is more important to you? I know you want the strap, but what good is that if the Christmas show is finished?
They're both important to me! That's why I'm in such a tizzy over it.
Then you need to make sure you find someone you can go with.
All my friends are so busy this time a' year, and I can't nab any of 'em.
That's the holidays for you. I'm busy with work myself, and I can hardly go an hour without my secretary calling me.
Really? Sounds rough, Akiyama-san.
Why do things always get even busier when it's already Christmas? It's such a hassle.
I hear that. I wish the busy times would limit themselves to just the end of the fiscal year.
Maybe wait it out? Once Christmas is over schools go on break, and work will drop off. Your friends' schedules might clear up.
But then the Christmas show will be over! I gotta go now!
Oh, good point. Limited-time things are a hassle, aren't they?
Try asking someone else to get it for you. If you can't make it, maybe someone else can.
I said none of my friends can go! If I knew someone who could, I'd just go with them!
They don't have to be friends of yours. I'm sure someone who's gotten that strap already is auctioning it off or something.
Oh hey, you're right! You're sharp as a tack, Akiyama-san! I gotta go hunt it down!
I hope you find it.
Can you take time off work? A lot of girls work here, so it shouldn't be a problem for you to take just one day off.
Can't do that. December's the best time of year for earnings. Also a lotta clients use Christmas as an excuse to bring us presents.
Good point. If a girl at my club asked for a day off at this time of the year, I'd have a hard time approving it.
Right? I mean I like amusement parks, but my customers are important.
Unfortunately, it looks like you might need to give up on trying to see this show.
Which is more important to you? The show is only happening right now. You'll regret it if you don't go.
Okay, that settles it! I'm gonna ask for time off and go see that show!
Good idea. Working hard is all well and good, but it's no good to stress yourself out.
Aha, that's it!
Take one of your customers with you! Like on a pre-shift date. Then you'll be able to work and still see the show!
Oh yeah! I've been buried under so much work and studyin' that I hadn't even thoughta that!
Heheh.
I recently had a slip-up with drinkin'... It's somethin' I haven't done in a while.
Oh? What kind of slip-up are we talking?
I wound up drinkin' so much I blacked out.
I do that a lot. I wind up back at home, with no memory of how I even got there a bit too often.
How can ya just be okay with that? I'm all weirded out by not knowin' what I mighta done.
That's no good. You're a girl, so you need to be careful or bad things might happen.
Yeah. I definitely regret it.
Also, I think I lost the coat I was wearin'. I don't even remember takin' it off. I wonder where it could be.
You went home in this cold weather without a coat? Wow, you must've been really drunk.
Darn it. I'm more upset about losin' the coat than about not rememberin' stuff!
Be careful when you drink. It's good to have fun, but too much will lead to poor decisions and you'll become a nuisance to others.
Yeah. Like I think I mighta smacked my friend upside the head...
Sounds like you're a mean drunk. And here I figured you could hold your liquor pretty well.
Nah, not really. I usually drink weak stuff like sours, so when I drink somethin' like wine, I lose it pretty easily.
I see. Well, I'm glad you're all right. It's a shame about the coat, but just be more careful next time.
Okay! If ya ever think I'm drinkin' too much, make sure to stop me, 'kay?
Sure, it's a deal.
Did you really hit her? You said you didn't remember anything, so maybe you're imagining it.
For whatever reason, hittin' my friend is the one thing I seem to remember clearly.
She seemed so ticked off, I'm afraid to even apologize now. Maybe I oughta keep my head low not say anythin' until the heat dies down?
No, you should definitely apologize now, before the gulf between you gets even wider.
Yeah, okay. Man, this is the pits...
Why'd you hit her?
I was tryin' to be the funny man, but she wasn't playin' along. So I told her she was no fun and smacked her.
Sounds like you were just being a drunk. Your rep will go down if you act like that.
What am I gonna do if my friends don't wanna go drinkin' with me anymore? Oh no, what am I gonna do!? I'm totally bummed!
What's done is done. There's no point dwelling on the past. Just go ahead and apologize.
Are you sure it's gone? Have you looked hard for it? Maybe it's in the washing machine.
I looked but I couldn't find it! I got no idea where I coulda left it!
You'll find it eventually. Chin up.
Yeah, I hope so...
Have you asked around? If someone finds it, I'm sure they'll get it back to you.
I'll go and do that.
You're so nice to me, Akiyama-san. You'll hafta watch after me if I get drunk!
Hey, I always look after the ladies.
Want me to buy you a new one? Maybe if you think of it like you'd just exchanged it for a new one, the loss won't sting as much.
No way! I really loved that coat. My grandma bought it for me when I graduated from high school.
Ah. Sounds like it meant a lot to you.
Aww, I hope someone finds it!
